summary: Edits and creates attributes on a per-vertex, rather than per-point, basis, including color, alpha, UV texture coordinates, crease weights, and custom vertex attributes.

key_params.name: group
key_params.note: Limit vertex edits to selected geometry.

key_params.name: doclr
key_params.note: Keep, add, or remove vertex color attributes.

key_params.name: douvw
key_params.note: Keep, add, or remove vertex texture coordinates.

key_params.name: docrease
key_params.note: Keep, add, or remove creaseweight values.

common_gotchas: Vertex attributes are not point attributes; shared points can have different values on different primitive corners.
The current official page does not expose normal editing controls for Vertex SOP, so do not plan it as a normal editor.
Second-input primitive or vertex mismatches cycle through primitives or ignore extra first-input vertices.
Crease weights describe the edge from the current vertex to the next vertex in the primitive, so ordering matters.
Subdivide SOP is the practical viewer for crease-weight effects; values must be greater than zero to matter.
key_concepts: Vertex SOP edits attributes per vertex, not per point, so different corners sharing one point can carry different values.
A second input can supply matching attribute values; fewer primitives cycle and extra vertices in the first input are ignored.
Diffuse color, alpha, texture coordinates, crease weights, and custom attributes are the official current vertex attribute surface.
If an attribute exists as a point attribute, adding it in Vertex SOP can elevate it to a vertex attribute, because an attribute cannot exist on both points and vertices.
